## EcclesiaOS v1.0.54

### Media uploads and Website Studio

- Fixed production media-picker uploads using malformed `/public/` URLs.
- Added canonical Laravel-generated media, upload, and storage URLs for local and production deployments.
- Applied the canonical media URL handling to section-builder image controls.
- Redesigned the Website Studio media library with branded contrast, clearer upload controls, and an improved empty state.
- Added regression coverage for production-safe media URLs.
